title: Deep Distance Transform for Tubular Structure Segmentation in CT Scans
mechanism: A multi-task head predicts the mask and a per-pixel distance map to the structure surface. The mask is then refined with a shape prior rebuilt from that map.
adaptation: An auxiliary head regresses truncated distance to the crack label centerline, capped at 4 px (the dark-line FWHM). This target degrades smoothly under 1 to 2 px label jitter. Use it as an extra crack cue and for ridge-following refinement.
min_experiment: Arm: house + distance head (L1, weight 0.5). Baseline: house. Metrics: crack relF1@2 and IoU on test and E1. Kill if the relF1@2 gain is < 0.01 on both test and E1.
evidence: R: six CT datasets, more than 13% DSC gain on pancreatic duct.
prior_overlap: none. Offset-tolerant CE and Skeleton Recall are different mechanisms. D11 (centerline regression) overlaps as a formulation, but here the distance map is an auxiliary head next to CE.

alt_notes.adaptation: For crack use distance-to-skeleton bins 0..4 px; for inactive true distance to boundary; radius head yields crack width per source and inactive area fraction for severity.
